invite.title: Invite a colleague
invite.hint: The invite link is valid for 7 days and works once. Inviting the same email again replaces the previous link.

notices.roleChanged: Role changed. It applies from the member's next action.
notices.deactivated: Member deactivated. They can no longer log in.
notices.revoked: Invite withdrawn; its link no longer works.

errors.FORBIDDEN: Only an agency admin can do that, and nobody can change their own role.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That member or invite no longer exists.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: That email already belongs to a member of your agency.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Please check the email and role.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many changes. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

publicProfile.title: Your portal profile
publicProfile.intro: Choose whether inmolink.es shows a page about you, linked from your agency's profile. Only what you enter here is shown, and only while your agency is verified.
publicProfile.publishedHint: Off: nobody sees your profile. You can turn it off at any time.
publicProfile.contactHint: Leave empty to publish no phone or e-mail. Your login e-mail is never shown.

photo.title: Photo
photo.current: A photo is uploaded. The portal shows a resized copy while your profile is published.
photo.file: Choose a photo (PNG, JPEG or WebP, max 900 KB)
photo.saveFirst: Save your profile first, then add a photo.

status.live: Published: your page is on inmolink.es while your agency is listed.

errors.invalidInput: Please check the name, languages, phone and e-mail.
errors.conflict: Your profile changed in another window. Reload the page and try again.
errors.forbidden: You cannot change this profile now.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: Upload a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The photo is larger than 900 KB.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many uploads. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
